# RunArgs

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/scene/`](../folders/src-scene.md)
> **Source:** [`src/scene/run_args.h`](../../../src/scene/run_args.h), [`src/scene/run_args.cpp`](../../../src/scene/run_args.cpp)

## Summary

Parsed key=value process arguments: scene, variables, mode, capture and probe settings.

## Description

Produced by parseRunArgs (argv[0] skipped). In dynamical it is emplaced in the host registry by the Game constructor; dynamical_train keeps it as a local and passes it to TrainHost. With capture or probe set, fixed_frame_dt defaults to 1/60 and window_hidden to true unless given. deterministic() is fixed_frame_dt > 0 and switches off wall-clock use (frame clock, physics timings), asynchronous terrain generation and collider prefetch. Read via ctx().find by Renderer, Windu, UISys, the physics systems (deterministic() helper in physics_sys.cpp), ChunkGeneratorSys::tick and ModelWatcherSys::tick.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scene` | `std::string` | "" | scene=: scene name or .json path; empty: base (dynamical) / walker_train or null (dynamical_train) |
| `vars` | `std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>>` | empty | var.<name>=<value>, command-line order, last wins |
| `mode` | `std::string` | "" | mode=: dynamical_train bench \| null \| train (empty: train) |
| `threads` | `int` | 0 | threads= >= 0: worker threads (bench, train) |
| `ticks` | `int64_t` | 0 | ticks= >= 0: dynamical exits after this many frames when > 0; bench tick count (600 when 0) |
| `episodes` | `int` | 0 | episodes= >= 0; parsed but not read by code in this area |
| `seed` | `int64_t` | 0 | seed= >= 0: base seed of the worlds in dynamical |
| `capture` | `std::string` | "" | capture=: capture script (JSON) |
| `capture_dir` | `std::string` | "captures" | capture_dir=: output directory of the PNGs |
| `fixed_frame_dt` | `double` | 0 (1/60 with capture or probe) | fixed_frame_dt= >= 0, decimal or fraction a/b; > 0 makes the frame clock ignore the wall clock |
| `window_hidden` | `bool` | false (true with capture or probe) | window_hidden=true\|false\|1\|0 |
| `exit_after_capture` | `bool` | true | exit_after_capture=: quit when the capture script is done |
| `probe` | `std::string` | "" | probe=: CSV output file of the Probe |
| `probe_entities` | `std::string` | "RigidBody" | probe_entities=: RigidBody or Transform (validated by Probe) |
| `probe_every` | `int` | 60 | probe_every= > 0: sampling period in frames |
